notes: TriVision made consumer/prosumer NC-series WiFi IP cameras. The brand is effectively defunct as an IP-camera maker: trivision.ca is dead and trivision.com is an unrelated billboard/signage company. The successor domain trivisiontech.com now redirects to trivisionsecurity.com, which sells sewer/pipe inspection and 'planetary' cameras — not the old NC IP cameras. The only surviving TriVision camera document located (trivisiontech.com Quick-Guide-for-IOS-Android-201701.pdf, via Wayback) is an app/cloud setup guide and contains no RTSP URL. No official manufacturer source publishes the RTSP path, so status is unverified. Default RTSP port assumed 554 but not officially documented.
